Name: BeaverBuddies MultiColony (beta)
Description: Co-op Timberborn with a colony each: every player runs their own districts, beavers and science on one map, with no borders, and the colonies barter through trading posts. Beta. Built on BeaverBuddies by thomaswp and the BeaverBuddies Stability Fork. Do not enable another BeaverBuddies mod alongside it.
